failures.detail: 立雪 s1 o1: The narrative says Shen-guang stands unmoving through heavy night snow until it rises above his knees; Bodhidharma asks, ‘You have stood long in the snow; what do you seek?’
立雪 s1 o1 expected '五燈會元': The narrative says Shen-guang stands unmoving through heavy night snow until it rises above his knees; Bodhidharma asks, ‘You have stood long in the snow; what do you seek?’
立雪 s1 o3: Asked the exact meaning of coming from the West, the master says, ‘Standing in snow was not yet toil; cutting off the arm was the real thing.’
立雪 s1 o3 expected '五燈會元': Asked the exact meaning of coming from the West, the master says, ‘Standing in snow was not yet toil; cutting off the arm was the real thing.’
立雪 s1 o4: A later master criticizes both stock acts: ‘Bodhidharma's nine years facing a wall—the source of ghosts; the Second Patriarch standing in snow to seek mind—turned into unworthiness.’

立雪 s1 o4 expected '五燈嚴統(第10卷-第25卷)': A later master criticizes both stock acts: ‘Bodhidharma's nine years facing a wall—the source of ghosts; the Second Patriarch standing in snow to seek mind—turned into unworthiness.’

立雪 s1 o5: A monk asks, ‘What is the meaning of the Second Patriarch standing waist-deep in snow?’ The master answers, ‘A leap month comes once in three years,’ then answers a follow-up about transmitting the teaching and robe.
